note: Iterates over each subtable in the morx chain; subtable count is read from the font table.
Applies a single morx subtable; the subtable's coverage flags and state machine are processed.
Runs the AAT state machine over the glyph buffer; state and entry indices are derived from the table.
Transitions between states using the state array; state index is used to index into the state table.
Entry index computed from state and glyph class; if the table is malformed, this index can be out of bounds.
Entry flags and newState are read; a crafted table can set flags that trigger buffer mutation operations.
The newState value from the entry is used to move the buffer cursor; a large newState can cause an out-of-bounds read/write on the glyph buffer.
A malformed entry can cause an out-of-bounds write when replacing glyphs in the buffer, leading to memory corruption.
